scope: B04 D11 cluster column composition, original-schema admission, shared application and index/notification consumers; existing-owner maintenance, no package acceptance
changes: CHANGE and RENAME no longer return prematurely from bundle lowering; MODIFY shares standalone lowering validation and every supported sibling is retained.
Single and bundled MODIFY/RENAME prepare original columns and apply one stable-ID replacement owner; evolving offsets and index names retain column identity.
Column and index admission resolves original schema names before execution. Local and cluster callers share check_multi_schema_names using Go MultiSchemaInfo categories and conflict order.
Conditional no-op columns/indexes preserve notes and create no jobs; same-name rename creates no job after CHECK dependency validation. Notifications omit skipped jobs and retain merged-index order.

The unsafe same-family type reinterpretation bypass is removed. Metadata-only widening remains supported; operations requiring the unimplemented row-reorganization worker return8200 before publication.

Premature branches, duplicate index-renaming loops, unnecessary MODIFY/RENAME table clones and late duplicate-index/CHECK job checks are retired. A stale added-column-index success fixture now targets an original column; its invalid SQL has a1072 regression. Misleading reorganization parity comments are corrected. Two stale database-bootstrap fixtures become one maintained table-driven case without losing Go serialization/charset obligations; repeated historical rollups in the audit index are removed.
